title: 第4章 宁做齐国犬，不做乾国人！
slug: 皇家县令我每日躺着收税
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这鸟不拉屎的地方，居然还有这么嚣张的人？

张宁循声望去，就见两个捕快，押着一个衣衫褴褛，满脸是血，看不清长相的人迎面走来。

在三人身后，还跟着一个捂着鼻子，穿着一身上好绸缎，趾高气扬的公子哥。

“你这不知死活的贱民，以为报官就能奈何得了本公子？等着，一会儿到了县衙，看本公子怎么收拾你这个狗东西。”

其中一个捕快，连忙回头讨好道：“钱公子，您什么身份，对这种贱民动手，不是脏了您的手吗？这种脏活，就交给小的吧。”

“想给这贱民，上什么手段，钱公子吩咐便是。”另一名捕快也道。

钱公子故作犹豫道：“这是不是太麻烦两位了？”

“哪里话，为钱公子办事，那是我们的荣幸。”两名捕快不约而同道。

“你，你们这些畜生，你们的眼里还有没有王法？”满脸是血的人，绝望怒吼。

“哈哈哈。”钱公子得意大笑，“王法？你这贱民难道不知，在这荒山县，本公子就是王法？”

“畜生，我跟你拼了。”满脸是血的人奋力挣扎。

然而，瘦弱的他，哪里是两名捕快的对手，这两名捕快一人一脚，就把他踹得跪倒在地。

这两名捕快，正愁没机会在钱公子面前表现，将人踹倒后，抡起拳头，就要继续大打出手。

但就在这时，一道冷笑声传来，“就因为你姓钱，所以这乾国的王法，也姓钱了？”

四人一愣，待看到不远处的张宁和凝香时，神色均是一变。

两名捕快迅速对视一眼，这不是那个新来的废物县太爷吗？他怎么还没饿死？

钱公子却是双眼放光，死死盯着凝香，“有趣，此地竟还没有本公子，没见过的俊俏小娘子。”

“姑娘，快跑啊，这些畜生狼狈为奸，他们不会放过你的。”满脸是血的人挣扎起身，焦急大吼。

钱公子面露愠怒，一脚将这人踹倒在地，然后露出一个自以为和善的笑容，“嘿嘿，小娘子别怕，你看本公子这一身穿着，本公子怎么可能是坏人呢？”

凝香下意识皱起了眉头。

可还没等她说话，张宁就将她挡在了身后。

凝香一怔，不敢置信地看着张宁的背影。

Page (1/3)

There are still such arrogant people in this place where birds don't shit?

Zhang Ning followed the sound and saw two police officers escorting a man in ragged clothes, his face covered with blood, and his appearance could not be seen clearly.

Behind the three of them, there was also a arrogant young man holding his nose, wearing fine silk and satin.

"You are a low-spirited pariah, do you think you can do anything to get rid of me by reporting to the official? Wait, we will arrive at the county government office in a while and see how I deal with this piece of shit like you."

One of the detectives quickly turned around and said to flatter him: "Master Qian, who are you? If you do something to this untouchable, isn't it dirtying your hands? Leave this kind of dirty work to the younger ones."

"Whatever method you want to use on this untouchable, Mr. Qian just orders it." Another policeman also said.

Mr. Qian pretended to hesitate and said, "Isn't this too much trouble for you two?"

"By the way, it's our honor to work for Mr. Qian." The two detectives said in unison.

"You, you beasts, do you still have the law in your eyes?" The man with his face covered in blood roared in despair.

"Hahaha." Mr. Qian laughed proudly, "Wang Fa? Don't you know, a pariah, that in this barren mountain county, I am Wang Fa?"

"Beast, I'll fight you." The man with his face covered in blood struggled hard.

However, being so thin, he was no match for the two detectives. The two detectives kicked him to the ground with one kick.

The two detectives were worried that they had no chance to show off in front of Mr. Qian. After kicking the man down, they raised their fists and were about to continue fighting.

But at this moment, a sneer came, "Just because your surname is Qian, the king of Qian Kingdom is also surnamed Qian?"

The four of them were stunned for a moment. When they saw Zhang Ning and Ning Xiang not far away, their expressions changed.

The two detectives looked at each other quickly. Isn't this the new good-for-nothing county magistrate?Why hasn't he starved to death yet?

Mr. Qian's eyes were shining brightly as he stared at Ningxiang, "Interesting, there is no handsome young lady like me here."

"Girl, run quickly, these beasts are working together, they won't let you go." The man with his face covered in blood struggled to get up and shouted anxiously.

Mr. Qian looked sulky, kicked the man to the ground, and then showed a smile that he thought was kind, "Hey, don't be afraid, little lady, look at what I'm wearing, how can I be a bad person?"

Ningxiang frowned subconsciously.

But before she could speak, Zhang Ning blocked her behind him.

Ningxiang was startled and looked at Zhang Ning's back in disbelief.
